facts.text: The Trader Agreement is provided in the dashboard only after a funded account is granted.
facts.excerpt: All clients are required to complete and pass KYC verification prior to executing trades on a simulated funded account. Upon receiving access to a simulated funded account, a Trader Agreement will be provided within the trader dashboard for the client to review and sign. The trading account will remain in read-only mode until both the KYC verification and the Trader Agreement are successfully completed and signed.
